verses.arabicText: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرْوًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wal-dhāriyāti dharwan
verses.translation: By the winds scattering ˹dust˺

verses.arabicText: فَٱلْحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقْرًۭا
verses.transliteration: Fal-ḥāmilāti wiq'ran
verses.translation: and ˹the clouds˺ loaded with rain

verses.arabicText: فَٱلْجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسْرًۭا
verses.transliteration: Fal-jāriyāti yus'ran
verses.translation: and ˹the ships˺ gliding with ease

verses.arabicText: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمْرًا
verses.transliteration: Fal-muqasimāti amran
verses.translation: and ˹the angels˺ administering affairs by ˹Allah’s˺ command

verses.arabicText: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Innamā tūʿadūna laṣādiqun
verses.translation: Indeed, what you are promised is true

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa-inna d-dīna lawāqiʿun
verses.translation: And the Judgment will certainly come to pass

verses.arabicText: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
verses.transliteration: Wal-samāi dhāti l-ḥubuk
verses.translation: ˹And˺ by the heavens in their marvellous design

verses.arabicText: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Innakum lafī qawlim-mukh'talifin
verses.translation: Surely you are ˹lost˺ in conflicting views ˹regarding the truth˺

verses.arabicText: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
verses.transliteration: Yu'faku ʿanhu man ufik
verses.translation: Only those ˹destined to be˺ deluded are turned away from it

verses.arabicText: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qutila l-kharāṣūn
verses.translation: Condemned are the liars—

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ سَاهُونَ
verses.transliteration: Alladhīna hum fī ghamratin sāhūn
verses.translation: those who are ˹steeped˺ in ignorance, totally heedless

verses.arabicText: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.transliteration: Yasalūna ayyāna yawmu d-dīn
verses.translation: They ask ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yawma hum ʿalā n-nāri yuf'tanūn
verses.translation: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be tormented over the Fire

verses.arabicText: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Dhūqū fit'natakum hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi tastaʿjilūn
verses.translation: ˹They will be told,˺ “Taste your torment! This is what you sought to hasten.”

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.transliteration: Inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātiw-waʿuyūnin
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and springs

verses.arabicText: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Ākhidhīna mā ātāhum rabbuhum innahum kānū qabla dhālika muḥ'sinīn
verses.translation: ˹joyfully˺ receiving what their Lord will grant them. Before this ˹reward˺ they were truly good-doers ˹in the world˺

verses.arabicText: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Kānū qalīlam-mina al-layli mā yahjaʿūn
verses.translation: they used to sleep only little in the night

verses.arabicText: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wabil-asḥāri hum yastaghfirūn
verses.translation: and pray for forgiveness before dawn

verses.arabicText: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
verses.transliteration: Wafī amwālihim ḥaqqul-lilssāili wal-maḥrūm
verses.translation: And in their wealth there was a rightful share ˹fulfilled˺ for the beggar and the poor

verses.arabicText: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wafī l-arḍi āyātul-lil'mūqinīn
verses.translation: There are ˹countless˺ signs on earth for those with sure faith

verses.arabicText: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wafī anfusikum afalā tub'ṣirūn
verses.translation: as there are within yourselves. Can you not see

verses.arabicText: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wafī s-samāi riz'qukum wamā tūʿadūn
verses.translation: In heaven is your sustenance and whatever you are promised

verses.arabicText: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّۭ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fawarabbi s-samāi wal-arḍi innahu laḥaqqum-mith'la mā annakum tanṭiqūn
verses.translation: Then by the Lord of heaven and earth! ˹All˺ this is certainly as true as ˹the fact that˺ you can speak

verses.arabicText: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Hal atāka ḥadīthu ḍayfi ib'rāhīma l-muk'ramīn
verses.translation: Has the story of Abraham’s honoured guests reached you ˹O Prophet˺

verses.arabicText: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Idh dakhalū ʿalayhi faqālū salāman qāla salāmun qawmum-munkarūn
verses.translation: ˹Remember˺ when they entered his presence and greeted ˹him with˺, “Peace!” He replied, “Peace ˹be upon you˺!” ˹Then he said to himself,˺ “˹These are˺ an unfamiliar people.”

verses.arabicText: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍۢ سَمِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Farāgha ilā ahlihi fajāa biʿij'lin samīnin
verses.translation: Then he slipped off to his family and brought a fat ˹roasted˺ calf

verses.arabicText: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Faqarrabahu ilayhim qāla alā takulūn
verses.translation: and placed it before them, asking, “Will you not eat?”

verses.arabicText: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Fa-awjasa min'hum khīfatan qālū lā takhaf wabasharūhu bighulāmin ʿalīmin
verses.translation: ˹They did not eat,˺ so he grew fearful of them. They reassured ˹him˺, “Do not be afraid,” and gave him good news of a knowledgeable son

verses.arabicText: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍۢ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Fa-aqbalati im'ra-atuhu fī ṣarratin faṣakkat wajhahā waqālat ʿajūzun ʿaqīmun
verses.translation: Then his wife came forward with a cry, clasping her forehead ˹in astonishment˺, exclaiming, “˹A baby from˺ a barren, old woman!”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Qālū kadhāliki qāla rabbuki innahu huwa l-ḥakīmu l-ʿalīm
verses.translation: They replied, “Such has your Lord decreed. He is truly the All-Wise, All-Knowing.”

verses.arabicText: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla famā khaṭbukum ayyuhā l-mur'salūn
verses.translation: ˹Later,˺ Abraham asked, “What is your mission, O messengers?”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qālū innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmim-muj'rimīn
verses.translation: They replied, “We have actually been sent to a wicked people

verses.arabicText: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن طِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Linur'sila ʿalayhim ḥijāratam-min ṭīnin
verses.translation: to send upon them stones of ˹baked˺ clay

verses.arabicText: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.transliteration: Musawwamatan ʿinda rabbika lil'mus'rifīn
verses.translation: marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”

verses.arabicText: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-akhrajnā man kāna fīhā mina l-mu'minīn
verses.translation: Then ˹before the torment˺ We evacuated the believers from the city

verses.arabicText: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Famā wajadnā fīhā ghayra baytim-mina l-mus'limīn
verses.translation: But We only found one family that had submitted ˹to Allah˺

verses.arabicText: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.transliteration: Wataraknā fīhā āyatal-lilladhīna yakhāfūna l-ʿadhāba l-alīm
verses.translation: And We have left a sign there ˹as a lesson˺ for those who fear the painful punishment

verses.arabicText: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wafī mūsā idh arsalnāhu ilā fir'ʿawna bisul'ṭānim-mubīnin
verses.translation: And in ˹the story of˺ Moses ˹was another lesson,˺ when We sent him to Pharaoh with compelling proof

verses.arabicText: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Fatawallā biruk'nihi waqāla sāḥirun aw majnūnun
verses.translation: but Pharaoh was carried away by his power, saying ˹of Moses˺, “A magician or a madman!”

verses.arabicText: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Fa-akhadhnāhu wajunūdahu fanabadhnāhum fī l-yami wahuwa mulīmun
verses.translation: So We seized him and his soldiers, casting them into the sea while he was blameworthy

verses.arabicText: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
verses.transliteration: Wafī ʿādin idh arsalnā ʿalayhimu r-rīḥa l-ʿaqīm
verses.translation: And in ˹the story of˺ ’Âd ˹was another lesson,˺ when We sent against them the devastating wind

verses.arabicText: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Mā tadharu min shayin atat ʿalayhi illā jaʿalathu kal-ramīm
verses.translation: There was nothing it came upon that it did not reduce to ashes

verses.arabicText: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wafī thamūda idh qīla lahum tamattaʿū ḥattā ḥīnin
verses.translation: And in ˹the story of˺ Thamûd ˹was another lesson,˺ when they were told, “Enjoy yourselves ˹only˺ for a ˹short˺ while.”

verses.arabicText: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Faʿataw ʿan amri rabbihim fa-akhadhathumu ṣ-ṣāʿiqatu wahum yanẓurūn
verses.translation: Still they persisted in defying the commands of their Lord, so they were overtaken by a ˹mighty˺ blast while they were looking on

verses.arabicText: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍۢ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Famā is'taṭāʿū min qiyāmiw-wamā kānū muntaṣirīn
verses.translation: Then they were not able to rise up, nor were they helped

verses.arabicText: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Waqawma nūḥim-min qablu innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīn
verses.translation: And the people of Noah ˹had also been destroyed˺ earlier. They were truly a rebellious people

verses.arabicText: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍۢ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wal-samāa banaynāhā bi-aydiw-wa-innā lamūsiʿūn
verses.translation: We built the universe with ˹great˺ might, and We are certainly expanding ˹it˺

verses.arabicText: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَٰهِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wal-arḍa farashnāhā faniʿ'ma l-māhidūn
verses.translation: As for the earth, We spread it out. How superbly did We smooth it out

verses.arabicText: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wamin kulli shayin khalaqnā zawjayni laʿallakum tadhakkarūn
verses.translation: And We created pairs of all things so perhaps you would be mindful

verses.arabicText: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Fafirrū ilā l-lahi innī lakum min'hu nadhīrum-mubīnun
verses.translation: So ˹proclaim, O Prophet˺: “Flee to Allah! I am truly sent by Him with a clear warning to you

verses.arabicText: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Walā tajʿalū maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara innī lakum min'hu nadhīrum-mubīnun
verses.translation: And do not set up another god with Allah. I am truly sent by Him with a clear warning to you.”

verses.arabicText: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verses.transliteration: Kadhālika mā atā alladhīna min qablihim mir-rasūlin illā qālū sāḥirun aw majnūnun
verses.translation: Similarly, no messenger came to those before them without being told: “A magician or a madman!”

verses.arabicText: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
verses.transliteration: Atawāṣaw bihi bal hum qawmun ṭāghūn
verses.translation: Have they passed this ˹cliché˺ down to one another? In fact, they have ˹all˺ been a transgressing people

verses.arabicText: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Fatawalla ʿanhum famā anta bimalūmin
verses.translation: So ˹now˺ turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺, for you will not be blamed

verses.arabicText: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wadhakkir fa-inna dh-dhik'rā tanfaʿu l-mu'minīn
verses.translation: But ˹continue to˺ remind. For certainly reminders benefit the believers

verses.arabicText: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
verses.transliteration: Wamā khalaqtu l-jina wal-insa illā liyaʿbudūn
verses.translation: I did not create jinn and humans except to worship Me

verses.arabicText: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍۢ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
verses.transliteration: Mā urīdu min'hum mir-riz'qin wamā urīdu ay-yuṭ'ʿimūn
verses.translation: I seek no provision from them, nor do I need them to feed Me

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
verses.transliteration: Inna l-laha huwa r-razāqu dhū l-quwati l-matīn
verses.translation: Indeed, Allah ˹alone˺ is the Supreme Provider—Lord of all Power, Ever Mighty

verses.arabicText: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًۭا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
verses.transliteration: Fa-inna lilladhīna ẓalamū dhanūbam-mith'la dhanūbi aṣḥābihim falā yastaʿjilūn
verses.translation: The wrongdoers will certainly have a share ˹of the torment˺ like that of their predecessors. So do not let them ask Me to hasten ˹it˺

verses.arabicText: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fawaylul-lilladhīna kafarū miy-yawmihimu alladhī yūʿadūn
verses.translation: Woe then to the disbelievers when they face their Day which they are warned of
